summary: The research-agent grounding capture (goal evidence #7 / synthesis A7) requires a live Vertex AI call with ADC quota_project = a Google Cloud project that has aiplatform.endpoints.predict on gemini-3.5-flash. The current workstation's ADC is bound to panelyst-hackathon (returns 403 PERMISSION_DENIED), and the operator account cannot run `gcloud auth application-default set-quota-project ss-v2-prod` because the ADC OAuth scope lacks serviceusage.services.use on that project. This file is therefore the PR-ready disclosure pattern (same as A4 + A6 + A9 + A2): the code path is wired, the smoke test exists, and the operator handoff captures exactly how to refresh the live capture once ADC is realigned.

The operator's IAM check confirms `roles/owner` on ss-v2-prod, but ADC cannot retarget the quota project from this account because the OAuth scope lacks serviceusage.services.use.

research_in_loop_disclosure.rationale: ResearchInput.grounding_enabled defaults to False (GEMINI-MODELS §6.5). When the campaign workflow constructs a ResearchInput it must explicitly set groundingEnabled=True for the grounding path to fire. Per A7, that flag is not yet flipped by the brand-campaign workflow — research_brand in agents-cli-app is the in-loop grounded path, the research-agent grounding-on path is wired but operator-default-off.
